release_name: Truthful update-check message; corrected iOS location guidance
notes: Fixes two strings that actively misled users. (1) manualCheckUpdate reported Already up to date from inside its own catch block, so a failed network or JSON check told the user the opposite of the truth. A failed check now says the check could not be made and to try again when connected. (2) The Home Screen location guidance told users to open Settings and find an entry for this app - an entry Louis confirmed does not exist on his phone. Replaced with what was actually established by device testing: iOS gives no way to re-enable it from inside the app and there may be no Settings entry at all; location still works normally in the browser; and to keep a Home Screen icon, re-add it with Open as Web App turned OFF. Both verified live in English and French. Also re-ran the full website-versus-corpus comparison after this run of data edits: 506 of 534 website entries now match a corpus row exactly, 94.8 percent, up from 93 percent. All six remaining named-site mismatches were traced to the comparison script normalising names, not to gaps in the data - the corpus was confirmed to hold every one of them. No schedule data changed: 426 rows.
